card.name: Inside ordinal number words
card.fires_on: The middle or ending piece of a spelled-out ordinal like fifteenth, thirteenth, fiftieth or eleventh, just before the word is complete. It also fires on a few other partly spelled words.

modes.label: Ordinal endings
modes.description: Final piece of a spelled-out ordinal such as -teenth, -eth or -venth, before a noun like century, edition or amendment.
modes.example: the passage of the Thir<<teenth>> Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
